summary: Tested all photographer panel changes end-to-end: backend (music presets, expiry tiers, admin upload, AI story via Gemini) and frontend wizard (Couple upload, Theme 3-stage wizard, Venue parking, Media presets, Features credit costs, Publish expiry tiers). 5/6 backend tests pass; AI story endpoint works (initial run returned a valid Gemini-generated story) but hit Emergent LLM key rate-limit on a back-to-back retry call - intermittent only. All frontend flows pass with zero 4xx/5xx API errors.

minor.issue: Back-to-back calls within seconds returned 503 (Emergent LLM key 'AI muse resting briefly' quota throttling). First call returned a valid story. Recommend adding a small retry/backoff on the client or spacing tests.

verified_features: Admin login at /admin/login works with admin@wedding.com / admin123 and redirects to /admin/dashboard
Couple step: 3 photo uploads (bride / couple-solo / couple) all returned HTTP 200 from /api/admin/upload-image. NO 401 errors observed
Step list has exactly 9 steps with NO Events step: Couple, Theme, Story, Venue, Media, Stay & Video, Gifts, Features, Publish

Theme step renders ThemeDesignWizard with credit summary header (testid theme-wizard-credit-header) and breadcrumb '1. Theme > 2. Event > 3. Design'. Design stage displays 3 design cards (testid wizard-design-*) each with PREVIEW + USE THIS buttons
Venue step shows Parking Info card (testid parking-card) with toggle (testid parking-enabled-toggle); enabling reveals parking-text-input + parking-map-link inputs
Media step loads music presets - 4 mood filter buttons (devotional, classical, cinematic, romantic) and 60 presets loaded from /api/music/presets
Features step displays credit cost / FREE badges on every flag (FREE for RSVP/Guest Wishes/Countdown/Ambient Music, '3 CREDITS' for Live Photo Gallery, etc.)
Publish step shows ExpiryTierSelector (testid expiry-tier-card) with all 4 tier buttons: expiry-tier-1_month, expiry-tier-3_months, expiry-tier-6_months, expiry-tier-1_year
Backend: GET /api/admin/expiry-tiers (admin auth) returns 4 tiers with ids {1_month, 3_months, 6_months, 1_year}
Backend: POST /api/admin/upload-image (multipart PNG) returns 200 with /uploads/photos/... URL
Backend: POST /api/admin/ai/story works with Gemini-2.5-flash via Emergent LLM Key and returns a non-empty story (verified in standalone run)
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is very large (~13.6K lines) - consider modularising by domain (admin, music, ai, expiry, uploads) for maintainability
The ai_generate_story docstring still says 'via Claude Sonnet 4.5' but the implementation uses gemini-2.5-flash - update the comment for clarity

Theme wizard remembers previously selected stage on re-entry which is good UX but makes direct re-test of the 10-theme grid trickier; consider exposing data-testid='theme-wizard-stage' attribute with current stage value for easier automation
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_photographer_panel_v2.py (new pytest suite for the photographer-panel changes)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded admin user only
context_for_next_testing_agent: All photographer panel changes verified working end-to-end. Photo upload uses /api/admin/upload-image and returns 200 (NO 401). Theme wizard cascades through 10 themes -> 6 events -> 3 designs and the ThemeDesignPreviewModal opens. Venue parking toggle reveals text+map inputs. Media step loads 60 music presets. Features step shows credit/FREE labels. Publish step renders all 4 expiry tiers. The AI Story endpoint is wired to Gemini 2.5 flash correctly; rate-limiting on Emergent LLM key may cause intermittent 503s under heavy testing - use a single test per run or add small sleep between AI calls. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_photographer_panel_v2.py covers all four key backend endpoints.
